question: Splashing the mud and racing across the fields, the roaring buffalos raced by a man are typical sights for which of the following festivals of Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kambala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The roaring buffalos running** through the plains are exciting to see, splashing through the mud.
 
• On the** first day of Kambala**, all of the buffalos participate in a run.
 
• Before the race, the buffalos are pitted against one another.
 
• The celebration is said to be held in honour of Lord Kadri Manjunatheshwara in order to seek blessings for a bountiful harvest.
 
• The festival is usually held over **two days**.
 
• The game is mostly run by farmers. This Karnataka native event may be worth seeing.
 
• Plan your journey to Mangalore during the Kambala race. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Pattadakkal Dance Festival** is an annual dance festival that takes place in Pattadakkal, a small town in Karnataka's southern state.
 
• **Karaga festival** celebrates Karnataka's rich cultural and religious heritage. It's a festival dedicated to the Goddess Shakti.
 
• **Mahamastakabhisheka** is one of the most important and important festivals for the Jain community, held every twelve years in Shravanabelagola, Karnataka.
